title: Bound the shared generation and repair budget
summary: Normal budget: one JD extraction, one complete application draft and at most two shared repair rounds.
body: Normal budget: one JD extraction, one complete application draft and at most two shared repair rounds. Malformed application attempts consume the same writing allowance. Do not loop until a model says PASS.
